name: 质量（检测/标准/合规）保证

map.输入光学元件检测参数（表面质量/波前误差/面形精度/偏心/透射比），依据ISO: Enter optical element inspection parameters (surface quality/wavefront error/form accuracy/decentration/transmittance) to automatically determine the quality grade and compliance per ISO 10110 and MIL-PRF-13830B.
map.📖 查看「光学元件质量合规检测 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Optical Element Quality Compliance Inspection User Guide"
map.综合评分 = Σ(各项评分 × 权重)；表面/PV/RMS/偏心/透射/等级/镀: Composite score = Σ(each item score × weight); surface/PV/RMS/decentration/transmission/grade/coating each 0-100 weighted
map.各子项按阈值映射到 0–100 分后加权求和，得到光学元件质量合规等级（A/B/: Each sub-item is mapped to 0-100 by threshold and then weighted and summed to obtain the optical element quality compliance grade (A/B/C).
map.表面质量按MIL-PRF-13830B：划痕# / 麻点#，如40/20: Surface quality per MIL-PRF-13830B: scratch# / dig#, e.g. 40/20
map.波前误差PV≤λ/4为标准级，≤λ/10为精密级: Wavefront error PV≤λ/4 is standard grade, ≤λ/10 precision grade
map.RMS通常为PV的1/5~1/3，RMS≤λ/14满足瑞利判据: RMS is usually 1/5-1/3 of PV; RMS≤λ/14 satisfies the Rayleigh criterion
map.偏心误差：精密级≤1'，标准级≤3'，商业级≤5': Decentration error: precision grade ≤1', standard ≤3', commercial ≤5'
map.📚 深度解析：光学元件质量合规检测: 📚 In-depth: Optical Element Quality Compliance Inspection
map.来料检验：按 ISO 10110 与 MIL-PRF-13830B 校核透镜/反: Incoming inspection: check the surface quality, wavefront error and decentration of lenses/mirrors per ISO 10110 and MIL-PRF-13830B.
map.等级判定：按精密级/标准级/商业级达标线复核综合得分，决定放行、降级或返修。: Grade determination: review the composite score against the precision/standard/commercial grade thresholds to decide release, downgrade or rework.
map.工艺定位：找出拉低得分的那一项（表面划痕麻点、PV/RMS 波前或透射比）再改工: Process localization: find the item that drags down the score (surface scratches/digs, PV/RMS wavefront or transmittance) and then improve the process.
map.表面质量、波前 PV/RMS、偏心、透射/反射比逐项按阈值映射为 0–100 分: Surface quality, wavefront PV/RMS, decentration and transmittance/reflectance are each mapped to 0-100 by threshold and then arithmetically averaged into a composite score; the thresholds are precision 90, standard 75, commercial 60. For example, surface 40-20 gives 75, PV 0.25λ gives 85, RMS 0.05λ gives 85, decentration 3′ gives 80, and AR coating transmittance 98% (standard 98%) gives 100 → composite 85, reaching standard grade but not precision grade.
map.综合得分低于所选等级达标线时判「未达 X 级」，同时给出实际达到的档位（如「标准: When the composite score is below the threshold of the selected grade, it is judged "below X grade", and the actually achieved grade is given (e.g. "standard grade qualified"), facilitating downgraded use or re-inspection after rework, avoiding the mistake of assuming the selected grade is met from the score alone.
map.MIL-PRF-13830B 的划痕/麻点编号，前为划痕号、后为麻点号，数字越小: The scratch/dig number of MIL-PRF-13830B; the first is the scratch number and the second the dig number, and the smaller the stricter: 40-20 is the requirement for ordinary elements, while precision elements often require 20-10 or even 10-5.
map.综合得分够高就一定合格吗？: Does a high enough composite score mean it is certainly qualified?
map.不是。合格与否看综合分是否达到所选等级的达标线（精密级 90、标准级 75、商业: No. Qualification depends on whether the composite score reaches the threshold of the selected grade (precision 90, standard 75, commercial 60); the score only reflects the relative level of each item, and the same score may fail at precision grade but pass at commercial grade.
map.关于「光学元件质量合规检测」: About the "Optical Element Quality Compliance Inspection"
map.光学元件质量检测与合规判定工具，支持透镜/反射镜/窗口片/棱镜/滤光片等元件类型: An optical element quality inspection and compliance determination tool, supporting element types such as lenses/mirrors/windows/prisms/filters; per ISO 10110 and MIL-PRF-13830B, it comprehensively scores five indices—surface quality, wavefront error, form accuracy, decentration error and transmittance—and automatically determines precision/standard/commercial grade compliance.
map.三种应用等级自动对标（精密/标准/商业）: Automatic benchmarking against three application grades (precision/standard/commercial)
map.波前误差PV与RMS双重评价: Dual evaluation of wavefront error PV and RMS
map.光学元件来料检验与验收: Optical element incoming inspection and acceptance
map.光学系统装调前质量筛查: Quality screening before optical system assembly and alignment
